# FastQC

`nf-core/fastqc`

A quality report for sequencing reads: the distribution of quality scores, the base content at each position, and other general metrics, so problems with a run show before alignment.

Homepage: https://www.bioinformatics.babraham.ac.uk/projects/fastqc/
